moments.author: Interstellar UAP
moments.quote: The Pentagon just released a photo of a 'Black Triangle' UFO captured by the FBI.
moments.why: This sparked a wildfire of discussion over newly declassified UAP files and conspiracy speculation.

moments.author: Disclosure Party
moments.quote: Newly released UAP files describe silent black triangles traveling up to 1,800 mph over sensitive U.S. military sites.
moments.why: Terrifying speed claims over military installations made the UAP files go viral.
